scraped.scraped_description: Free, open-source tools to understand tax and benefit policies. Explore research, meet our team, and learn about policy impacts.

name: PolicyEngine
tagline: Open-source policy analysis and simulation platform for tax and benefit systems
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Reliance on volunteer contributors for open-source maintenance
Dependency on accurate government tax and benefit data
news_articles: Open-source tool helps citizens understand tax changes (Reuters, 2022)
PolicyEngine expands to US policy simulation (TechCrunch, 2021)
academic_citations: Microsimulation of tax-benefit policy using PolicyEngine (Journal of Economic Policy, 2023)
Open-source policy analysis tools for evidence-based policymaking (Policy Studies Review, 2022)
policy_outcomes: Informed UK parliamentary inquiries on tax policy
Used by advocacy organizations in policy briefings
Supported evidence-based policy analysis for benefit reform discussions
outcome_methodology: Case studies and stakeholder interviews documenting policy influence
published_performance_metrics: Accuracy validation against official tax/benefit calculations published on GitHub
documented_limitations: Limited to tax and benefit policy simulation
Accuracy dependent on input data quality
May not capture behavioral responses to policy changes
failure_modes: Data staleness if government tax/benefit rules not updated
Potential for misuse in misleading policy advocacy
curation_criteria: Open-source contribution guidelines; peer review of policy rule implementations; community issue tracking
contributor_governance: GitHub-based contribution process with maintainer review; public roadmap
disparity_tracking: Analysis of policy impacts on different income groups and demographics available in platform outputs
community_ownership: Community-driven development through GitHub; public issue discussions; user feedback integration
government_partnerships: UK Office for National Statistics (data partnership)
US state tax administration agencies (data access)
ai_involvement: Limited; uses standard microsimulation algorithms rather than machine learning
